notes.title: Case 3: The Remorseful Doctor
notes.content: [h3][b]We’ve added a new full case to investigate![/b][/h3][p align="start"]In The Remorseful Doctor, you’ll look into the mysterious death of Danton, a heart surgeon who worked for the Zeus Health Alliance. Details are limited and the circumstances aren’t clear. Your job is to piece together what happened.[/p][p align="start"][b]What’s in this update:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New full-length case: The Remorseful Doctor[/p][/*][*][p]New dialogues, documents, and interviews to review[/p][/*][*][p]Additional contradictions to spot and debunk[/p][/*][*][p]General bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thanks for playing and for your continued feedback![/p]
